rebaselines.reason: Containment fix. `body` used `min-height: 100vh`, so the stage's content inflated the document past the viewport (904px of document in a 700px window). The stage reported 749px of available height, the scale resolved to 60% instead of 44%, and the 1180px-tall device was clipped while the containment assertion passed — it measured a stage that had already grown to fit the device it was supposed to bound.
rebaselines.effect: The document height now equals the viewport at every swept size (no page scroll). Covered by RVP-T02c, which fails if `min-height` returns.
rebaselines.authority: Same rule as the first record.

rebaselines.reason: Determinism: the frame and its scale wrapper transition on geometry changes, so the workbench was animating into its *initial* state on load. One freeze cell moved in one run of the gate and not another.
rebaselines.effect: `body.lab-booting` disables those transitions until the first geometry is committed. The initial paint is instantaneous; only user-initiated changes animate.
rebaselines.authority: A determinism fix to the measured surface, not a relaxation of the assertion.

rebaselines.reason: Reported from the lab: the bottom of the tested page was cut off and could not be scrolled to. The cause is in index.html itself — `body { height: 100vh; overflow: hidden }` pinned the body to the viewport, so content taller than the viewport was unreachable. The portal's content is ~1280px, so it was clipping at EVERY swept viewport (200px hidden at 1920x1080, 480px at 1280x800) and was also clipping the top of its own hero, because the centering pushed the title off-screen.
rebaselines.effect: index's html height becomes the content height (1279.5 at the desktop viewports, 1906 at mobile, 1929 at wearable) instead of the viewport height, and 56 elements shift with it. This is content becoming reachable, not moving relative to itself.
rebaselines.authority: The freeze catches *unintended* movement; a defect fix that makes hidden content reachable is intentional and is re-baselined with this record.

rebaselines.reason: The baseline predates the GQC-02B Astro host. Every page now carries the WorkbenchLayout head tags and the BPV-03 page-state contract elements (#page-status, #page-alert, visually hidden 1x1 px). Each remaining box move was attributed to a specified change by aligning the old and new DOM on tag and class order: index lost four of five portal cards in commit 9e08c3c (2026-10-20) and its alias buttons and two Penpot links in BPV-01, and gained the BPV-05 main landmark; responsive-lab gained GQC-02B islands and GQC-03 target chips, lost sprint copy in BPV-01 and the duplicate dock controls in BPV-04, and its relabelled toggles changed width; fiber-conformance gained the BPV-05 #harness main. Four unintended moves the freeze caught were fixed before this capture rather than recorded: the fiber-inspector #panel-status kept its Loading text (34.5 px shift), Astro HTML compression dropped a space in the fiber-inspector intro and after the icon in two app panel titles, and the BPV-04 div-to-button change on .mobile-back-btn added 2 px on phones.
